newsitem.title: CONGO: Air France to fly to Congo's economic capital.
newsitem.headline: Air France to fly to Congo's economic capital.

text.p: French state carrier Air France is to begin direct flights from France to oil-producing Congo's economic capital Pointe Noire once the runway has been widened, diplomats said on Thursday.

Tenders for widening the runway at Pointe Noire's Agostinho Neto airport from 35 metres (yds) to 50 metres (yds) were being invited with a view to completing the work by the start of April, they added.
Work on reinforcing the runway would begin after the new service, involving long-haul planes, begins, they said.
The diplomats said the cost of the project would be about 80 million CFA francs of which 50 million CFA would take the form of French development aid.
